name: Saint Martin's Island
summary: Bangladesh's only coral island: clear water, coconut palms, quiet beaches and sunset walks. A short trip from Teknaf, reachable only by ship.
season_note: Ships run roughly November to March or April when the sea is calm. In the rough season trips stop.
avoid_note: Rules for tourist numbers, overnight stays and ship schedules change. Always check the latest local government notice before you book.

reach.how: Bus or flight to Cox's Bazar, then road to Teknaf, then ship from Teknaf jetty (operators such as Keari Sindbad, Bay Cruise, Sea Truck)
reach.note: Ship takes 2 to 3 hours each way. Fares cover the ship ticket plus the road. Confirm the schedule the day before.

local.note: The island is small and walkable end to end in a few hours.
Good for the long beach road.

attractions.name: Chheradia (Cheradia) Island
attractions.what: A rocky tip reached at low tide, with corals and tide pools. A good place for sunset.
attractions.tip: Check the tide time before you go. Do not remove corals or shells.

attractions.name: West coast beach walk
attractions.what: Walk the long, quiet coastline under the coconut palms.

attractions.name: Snorkelling and swimming
attractions.what: Swim and snorkel in the clear shallows where the sea is calm.
attractions.tip: Rent a life jacket. Stay close to shore.

attractions.name: Sunset point
attractions.what: Sit on the sand for one of the best sunsets in the country.
attractions.tip: Bring a light jacket for the breeze.

attractions.name: Island village and local seafood
attractions.what: Walk through the fishing village, see dried fish and boats, eat the daily catch.
attractions.tip: Support local stalls and take your rubbish back.

luxury.note: Best island resorts; book well ahead.

rules: Do not litter, pick corals or buy shells or turtles.
No loud music or bonfires: the island is a protected area.
Keep your ship ticket and ID with you.
